name: shell
description: Give your agent a shell without giving it the keys to your machine.

issues.title: Agent-usability gaps: missing commands, flags, and shell syntax
[FEATURE] Publish the native Rust crate to crates.io
[BUG] curl -L resolves a protocol-relative `Location: //host/path` as a path on the current host
[FEATURE] Option to disable network access, and RFC 6598 shared address space (100.64.0.0/10) in the SSRF blocklist
FileStat should carry owner, link count and device numbers
[BUG] printf %s with a huge width grows memory without bound
[BUG] A double-quoted empty word ("") is dropped from a command's arguments
[BUG] `command -v` ignores redirects, so `command -v X >/dev/null` still prints X

latest_release.name: v0.6.0
latest_release.body:
## v0.6.0

### 🚀 Features

- feat: let a kernel run commands Shell doesn't implement (#190) (da522f9)
- feat: make the interactive CLI an optional default feature (#172) (924927a)
- feat: add the builtin builtin (#174) (a202be8)
- feat: accept legacy -N line counts in head and tail (#171) (07df899)

### 🐛 Fixes

- fix: fail a write that goes past max_file_size (#198) (f5b232d)
- fix: run break, continue and exit inside command substitution (#189) (77b6309)
- fix(rm): report removal refusals, including under -f (#180) (e77c26b)
- fix: apply the input size limit to multiline input (#178) (cff867b)
- fix: return real statuses from compounds in command substitution (#179) (0e998a2)
- fix: stop recursion through pipelines at the depth limit (#177) (5d21d2b)
- fix: keep output truncation on a UTF-8 character boundary (#176) (fccc275)
- fix: report the timeout when a command succeeds past the deadline (#173) (cb193c3)
- fix(net): treat localhost with a trailing dot like localhost (#170) (bf831d1)
- fix: report a failed redirect on a builtin (#169) (11c76a5)
- fix(builtins): honor -- in unset and unalias (#168) (6633e4e)

### ⚡ Performance

- perf: stop re-resolving every prefix of a missing path (#175) (5d5b777)

### ✅ Tests

- test: run MCP tests against the binary Cargo built (#155) (855eb6c)
- test: pin the Rust API a custom Kernel depends on (#161) (647a42b)
- test: make mcp_shell_timeout actually expire and check recovery (#157) (9a20400)
- test: make three curl tests exercise the behavior they name (#158) (347993a)
- test: wait for the bind_direct write-back instead of sleeping 50 ms (#163) (f13dd6a)
- test: fix three limit and credential tests (#162) (ae88b96)
- test: pin the public TypeScript API of @strands-agents/shell (#160) (0ca14d7)
- test: pin the public Python API of strands_shell (#159) (f2757ab)
- test: give each test its own temporary directory (#154) (bba8d08)
- test: register empty_pipeline_stage_no_panic (#152) (76bd346)

### 👷 CI

- ci(rust): bump napi-derive from 3.6.12 to 3.6.13 (#184) (90ccbd9)
- ci(rust): bump tokio from 1.53.3 to 1.54.1 (#183) (793b057)
- ci(rust): bump napi from 3.14.2 to 3.15.0 (#182) (1d975bf)
- ci: bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 (#40) (0932d4c)
- ci(node): bump typescript from 6.0.3 to 7.0.2 (#54) (1c18a6e)
- ci(rust): bump inventory from 0.3.24 to 0.3.25 (#146) (1b03cac)
- ci(rust): bump rustyline from 18.0.0 to 19.0.0 (#166) (4f2802b)
- ci(rust): bump napi-derive from 3.6.11 to 3.6.12 (#143) (81d0723)
- ci(rust): bump serde_json from 1.0.151 to 1.0.154 (#149) (36f6dee)
- ci(rust): bump toml from 1.1.2+spec-1.1.0 to 1.1.8+spec-1.1.0 (#148) (962f16c)
- ci(rust): bump tokio from 1.53.1 to 1.53.3 (#165) (04d1d0a)
- ci(rust): bump rustls from 0.23.40 to 0.23.46 (#141) (4c184a2)
- ci: run doc tests and node-feature unit tests in the Rust job (#156) (91246fb)
- ci(rust): bump pyo3 from 0.29.3 to 0.30.1 (#164) (86b1085)
- ci(rust): bump syn from 3.0.2 to 3.0.9 (#153) (c12816a)
- ci(rust): bump pyo3 from 0.29.2 to 0.29.3 (#128) (3a0552a)

### 🔧 Chores

- chore: make strands-box-maintainers the code owners (#167) (0b2c8c0)
